name: @hanphone/dsh-a2a
description: Agent2Agent (A2A) v1.0.1 dual-end plugin for DeepSeek Harness: multiple inbound servers (per-instance agent presets; skills derived from each preset's skill directory), multiple outbound connections, GUI-managed instance lifecycle.
//peers: A2A runs inside a DSH harness composition: the host provides these. Local typecheck resolves them through tsconfig paths to the harness checkout, not from node_modules. The dsh-* ranges state the DSH runtime versions this plugin supports; the DSH 0.1.7+ peer-compatibility preflight evaluates only @deepseek-ai/dsh and @deepseek-ai/dsh-*, with prereleases participating. cordis and schemastery are declared for install-time peer resolution: the stable ranges cover the tested 4.0.x-4.1.x/3.x line, which includes the vendored 4.1.0/3.19.0 in the 0.2.2-rc.1 through 0.2.2-rc.3 harnesses; the trailing exact prereleases keep the 0.2.2-alpha.2, 0.2.1-alpha.2 and 0.2.1-rc.2 hosts covered.

scripts.build: tsc -b tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && tsdown && node scripts/build-client.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && tsc -p tsconfig.types.json
scripts.test:all: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm test:e2e
